items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And then you'd take Tommy Benford. Who would you take on bass? [INTERVIEWEE] Tommy -- I would take (unintelligible) bass, couldn't get George Dupvier...

ctx.x: He could be, yeah, because I know when I first met him, he had possibilities (unintelligible) maybe he was from Chicago.
And then you'd take Tommy Benford. Who would you take on bass?

Tommy -- I would take (unintelligible) bass, couldn't get George Dupvier, (unintelligible) but I'd take this other fellow there plays very good guitar and bass, and he does these things around these different colleges, writes and arranges, and he's got a well known name too in music.
